name: 4-TME
summary: 4-Thiometaescaline (4-TME), also known as 3-ethoxy-4-methylthio-5-methoxyphenethylamine, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the analogue of metaescaline in which the methoxy group at the 4 position has been replaced with a methylthio group.

pharmacology.text: The drug has approximately 4 times the potency of mescaline, though its effects are very different.

uses.en: It was described by Alexander Shulgin in his book PiHKAL and has rarely been used outside that work.
uses.zh: Alexander Shulgin在著作《PiHKAL》中描述過它，除此之外很少有人使用。
uses.zhHans: Alexander Shulgin在著作《PiHKAL》中描述过它，除此之外很少有人使用。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic phenethylamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, a faster heartbeat, raised blood pressure, muscle tension, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻苯乙胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、心跳加快、血壓升高、肌肉緊繃、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻苯乙胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、心跳加快、血压升高、肌肉紧绷、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: It is one of the mixed scalines, with a methoxy group on one side of the ring, an ethoxy group on the other, and a sulphur-linked methyl group in the middle. Despite its close likeness to mescaline, its effects are described as very different.
fact.zh: 它是混合型的scaline之一：環的一側是甲氧基，另一側是乙氧基，中間則是經由硫相連的甲基。雖然它與麥司卡林非常相似，作用卻被形容為很不一樣。
fact.zhHans: 它是混合型的scaline之一：环的一侧是甲氧基，另一侧是乙氧基，中间则是经由硫相连的甲基。虽然它与麦司卡林非常相似，作用却被形容为很不一样。
